👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `e45c845`: all 31 files reviewed.

4 finding(s): 3 to consider; 3 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### For your information

- ⚪❓ **Info · question: PR body's "Email wording" is not in this head (confidence high)** (`packages/i18n/messages/en.json:1413`): The description says email is its own destination with "Exporting for email", "Email copy ready", "Drag to an email" and a FOR EMAIL tag. At e45c845, `DESTINATION_IDS` has no `email` (apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:36-43), and none of the `progressTitle`, `readyTitle`, `pill`, `dragTo` or `destinationTag` selects in en.json or es.json has an `email` branch. The code is consistent with itself; only the description is ahead of it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 2.** Part 1 has nothing that blocks the merge. The fingerprint fix is correct: the runner stores `encodeFingerprint(content, preset)`, and the new code compares only the part before '#'. The session-wide minimized widget still shows errors in full. Retiring cards from the sidebar's route hook works because the Sidebar stays mounted on every shell page. One inconsistency: the new Library Ready to upload card calls Show in Finder and drag-out without `markCopySeen`. The ready toast calls it for both actions, and ready-copies.ts documents that acting on a ready card counts as seeing the copy. There is also one test whose name says it checks that the copy is forgotten, but it only checks the navigation.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I found no defects in the stylesheets, docs or messages in part 2. Nothing here needs fixing before merge.

- **Stylesheets:** every CSS variable they use is defined (`--bg-hover` has a fallback). The destination tag colours match the destination logos. The 3-column grid takes the two-column ready card. The bottom-right export stack sits clear of the 28px status bar.
- **Messages:** en.json and es.json have the same key set. The two removed keys (`hide`, `readyDragToUpload`) are no longer used anywhere in the app.
- **Docs:** the backlog doc's claims about when the ready card stays or goes match `ready-copies.ts` and the sidebar's route hook.

Two notes:
- **PR description (info):** the "Email wording" section describes an email destination and its text. Neither exists at this head: `DESTINATION_IDS` has no `email` and no message select has an `email` branch.
- **Doc banner (consider):** the banner and the backlog row say the work is stacked on #459, but the PR says #466.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (9 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- Show in Finder and drag-out from the Library's Ready to upload card (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:80`) — The card stays after the action. The copy keeps its unseen outline and chip until its page is opened. If it fails: revealLocalRecording's promise is voided, as in the sibling and use-local-library, so a rejection is silent in both places. startFileDrag is a fire-and-forget send. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:277-295`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:10-13`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:76-98`.
- Retire Ready to upload cards when the route leaves the Library (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:99`) — A later Library visit shows the plain grid, with the copy still outlined as unseen. If it fails: The Sidebar is mounted in AppShell, which hosts every page except sign-in, so the ref survives page changes. On a remount the ref starts false, so it can only miss one retire and never retires a card… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:92-106`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/app-shell.tsx:46-53`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/app/router.tsx:63-106`.
- Minimize the export widget to a pill, persisted in sessionStorage (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:25`) — The pill shows while an export runs and the widget is minimized. Clicking it restores the card. If it fails: If storage throws, both read and write fall back to the in-memory value. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:34-55`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:10-35`.
- Read a copy's destination from its sidecar fingerprint (content part before '#') (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/copy-destination.ts:13`) — Grid tags and the Copies-from-this-master rows name the destination. If it fails: For a preset that maps to no destination, destinationOfPreset returns undefined, so callers fall back to the kind badge or the film tile. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:440`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-reuse.ts:74`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:98-103`.
- Export widget and ready toast moved to a bottom-right fixed stack (`.exportStack`) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-stack.module.css:19`) — The progress card or pill and the ready toast show bottom right on every screen, 12px above the 28px status bar. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-stack.tsx:24-29`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-stack.module.css:2-12`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-card.module.css:5`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.module.css:77`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/app-shell.module.css:27`.
- Minimize the progress widget to a pill and expand it again; the state persists in sessionStorage (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:152`) — The pill shows a ring and "YouTube copy · N%" (en.json `pill`). Clicking it calls setExportWidgetMinimized(false). If it fails: If sessionStorage throws, read() returns false and the setter keeps the flag in memory only, so the widget falls back to expanded after a reload. The user sees nothing break. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:10-35`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:40-52`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:199-226`.
- New DestinationTag styles keyed by data-destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destination-tag.module.css:25`) — FOR YOUTUBE in red and so on, on the poster of the ready card and of grid cards. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destination-logo.module.css:8-29`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destination-tag.tsx:18-20`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:36-43`, `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:1431`.
- Removed i18n keys `hide` and `readyDragToUpload`; added `dragTo`, `pill`, `minimize`, `expand`, `destinationTag` and the others (`packages/i18n/messages/en.json:1413`) — Titles such as "Exporting for YouTube" and "YouTube copy ready", and "Drag to YouTube Studio". Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:62-64`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:97`, `packages/i18n/messages/es.json:1413-1435`.
- The doc's claims about the ready card's lifetime (open, ✕, leave the Library) (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/ready-copy-in-library.md:30`) — After ✕ or a return to the Library, the copy shows as a regular grid card with its pink outline. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:88-105`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:98-102`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:409-421`.

</details>
